'''Conflict of Interest, Funding and Disclosure Continuity'''是 Human Infra 在“外部生态承载”控制轴下维护的独立研究域。该词条同步项目研究材料，并将其放入主体持续性和可能性空间框架审查。

== 对 Human Infra 的作用 ==
关键词显示该域主要承载能源、水、食物、住房、治理、经济、通信、灾害或基础设施环境。

== 机制或依赖 ==

<pre>
研究域对象
  -> 影响变量或中间机制
  -> 改变主体状态、外部条件或路径可达性
  -> 改变风险、能力、时间成本或资源约束
  -> 改变有效寿命、有效时间或未来选择权
</pre>

本域位于 C5“可能性生态承载层”。其具体上下游依赖以项目分类表和下列域研究材料为准。

== 证据与来源 ==

本页面的分类、对象与研究边界来自 Human Infra 仓库的受治理域 README；README 是研究组织资料，不自动构成科学、医学、法律或工程事实证据。正文中的外部主张必须继续绑定论文原文、官方标准、监管文件、数据库或权威报告。

== 域研究材料 ==

<span id="scope"></span>
== Scope ==

This domain studies conflict-of-interest disclosure, funding statements, sponsor roles, competing interests, transparency declarations and disclosure updates across publications, datasets, code and research communication.

Human Infra treats disclosure continuity as an evidence-quality condition: a claim cannot be evaluated well if the incentives, sponsors and competing interests around it disappear.

<span id="human-infra-chain"></span>
== Human Infra Chain ==

<pre>research claim enters public reasoning
  -> claim may be shaped by funding, employment, ownership, consulting or sponsor influence
  -> disclosure records expose relevant incentive context
  -> readers can evaluate bias risk, independence and interpretation limits
  -> evidence can be weighted without relying only on narrative confidence
  -> long-term model governance becomes more robust</pre>
<span id="non-goals"></span>
== Non-Goals ==

* No legal, employment, grant compliance or publication-submission advice.
* No accusation of misconduct based solely on funding or relationships.
* No private financial, employment, grant, review or editorial data collection.
* No guidance for hiding, minimizing or laundering conflicts.

<span id="source-signals"></span>
== Source Signals ==

* ICMJE disclosure guidance: https://www.icmje.org/disclosure-of-interest/
* COPE guidance and resources: https://publicationethics.org/
* NIH grants policy and disclosure resources: https://grants.nih.gov/policy-and-compliance.htm
* Crossref funder metadata: https://www.crossref.org/services/funder-registry/

<span id="next-notes"></span>
== Next Notes ==

* Build disclosure source cards for funding, employment, equity, consulting, patents and sponsor role.
* Link this domain to trustworthy scientific communication, peer review and source-card evidence weighting.
* Track update failures, undisclosed sponsor role and stale disclosure records.

== 边界、失败条件和未知项 ==

* 本域是研究与建模单元，不提供个体医疗、法律、金融、工程、教育或安全操作建议。
* `review_status=heuristic-v0.1` 表示分类仍处于启发式复核阶段，不代表研究结论成立。
* 若缺少来源、适用对象、证据等级或反证条件，应把相关主张视为待核验，而不是事实。
* 域的存在不等于技术可行、干预有效、风险可接受或主体连续性得到证明。
